MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p
WHERE p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <= 2 OR CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) < 1)
WITH p.position AS position,
     CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) AS birth_month,
     CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH position,
     2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN position AS col1, AVG(age) AS col2
